checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Identify the entry point at EDGE-PRECOMPILE-INPUT. 2. The target interface is 'EVM Precompile Invocation (ALT_BN128, BLS12-381, BLAKE2F)'. 3. Security assumption to test: 'All precompile inputs arrive via transactions from untrusted users. ALT_BN128: validate input length (64/128/192*n bytes), field element < modulus, point on curve, subgroup membership. BLS12-381: validate input length per operation type, field elements < BLS12 modulus, point on curve, subgroup check (point * curve_order == infinity). BLAKE2F: validate input exactly 213 bytes, final flag in {0,1}. Gas must be correctly charged before execution.'. 4. Craft malformed inputs that violate: Each coordinate value extracted from ALT_BN128 input must be less than the field modulus. Values >= modulus must cause validation failure and OutOfGasError.. 5. Send inputs that are syntactically valid but semantically violate the property. 6. Verify the system rejects or safely handles all invalid inputs. 7. Check for error handling that leaks internal state. 8. Consider archetypal attacks: Submit malformed transactions with invalid nonces, high s-values, excessive gas ; Eclipse attacks, propagate blocks with incorrect difficulty calculations, send b; Propose blocks with forged EIP-7685 requests_hash, attempt to inject invalid EL .
